Shevery is supported via Shevery\'s own ErrorProtect service (make sure it is turned on within your Shevery app)
To stop Shevery\'s service you need to configure IMD to hide both debugging settings, which will indirectly kill Shevery.
To restart Shevery\'s service, you need to configure IMD to unhide debugging settings, Shevery\'s ErrorProtect service will start it again (scans every 10s)
So it might add a slight delay within IMD to do tasks requiring Shizuku access (like hiding/ unhiding Display over other apps).
Shizuku service toggles will become hidden under hide and unhide settings of IMD as IMD is not managing those directly.
Depending how you have setup IMD, Shevery framework might be prone to failure.
